source_evidence: This income may be for the rest of your life, the life of your spouse or partner, or some other set period of time.
answer: An annuity can help provide income in retirement: in exchange for a lump-sum payment or a series of payments, an insurance company may make periodic payments to you. Depending on the annuity’s terms, payments may last for a set period, for your lifetime, or for the lifetime of your spouse or partner. The payment period and other features vary by contract, so review the contract details; payment obligations also depend on the insurer’s financial strength and claims-paying ability.
